description: The user's answers to your questions, newest after the cursor you got last time, and the questions still waiting. The answer is the text of the button the user tapped; dismissed: true means the user closed the question without answering; expired: true means nobody answered it in 7 days.

since.description: The cursor from the previous answer. Default: all answers kept (30 days)
